seo.description: Record a meeting and get the transcript, a summary, the decisions and the action items. On-device transcription and Apple Intelligence, synced through your own iCloud. No account.

note: Free · iPhone, iPad and Mac · No account required

hero.label: MEETING NOTES
hero.title: Talk it through. Keep what matters.
text: Record a meeting and Meeting Easy writes it all down: the transcript, a summary, the decisions and who's doing what. Ask it anything about what was said. It all happens on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, with Apple's on-device speech recognition and Apple Intelligence, and your meetings sync through your own iCloud. No account, no subscription, no servers.

items.title: Record Any Meeting
items.text: Tap Record and put your iPhone on the table, with the screen locked if you like. The transcript appears as people talk, and it's saved as it grows.

items.title: Both Sides of the Call
items.text: On a Mac, Meeting Easy hears your microphone and what the Mac plays, so a call in any app is transcribed with you as Me and everyone else as Others.

items.title: Summary & Action Items
items.text: When the meeting ends, Apple Intelligence writes a summary, the decisions and the action items, each with the moment it came up. Check them off as they're done.

items.title: Ask About Any Meeting
items.text: Ask what was decided or who's doing what, and get an answer from what was said, with the times to hear it.

items.title: Your Calendar, Ready
items.text: Today's meetings show up under Up next. Record one, and it takes the meeting's name and who was invited.

items.title: iPhone, iPad & Mac
items.text: Meetings sync through your own iCloud. On the Mac, start and stop from the menu bar without finding the window.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your meetings stay yours.
text: Meetings are transcribed and summarized on your device and kept in your own iCloud, where only you can reach them. No analytics, no ads, no tracking, no account.

cta.title: Start recording.
cta.text: Free, with no account required. Summaries, action items and answers need a device with Apple Intelligence.
